text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the weigh-in! In this corner, dressed in charcoal training wear and white hand wraps, the Buzz Cut Bruiser himself! Version six welded the collar and culled the hidden skin, so no more skin poking through. Both idle feet plant flat, and he slimmed down to 45.7 megabytes. Realism climbs from 58 to 60! Still, those lumpy shorts, that smooth shell hair and skin begging for a subsurface glow need work. Approved and ready! Give it up for the one, the only, GROK!
